comparison.objective: Manipulate a two-handle faucet to diagnose one of three unannounced conditions and file a report.
comparison.physical_skill: Exploratory handle manipulation, fault inference, and tag placement.
comparison.success_condition: Report tag must be placed on the pad matching the observed condition; wrong reports receive only partial credit.
comparison.reason: Tests diagnosis from mechanism response, not precision impact, generated-part separation, insert retention, or containment. Detailed actuation thresholds are absent.
